title: 第九章 解除婚约第十章 母子共荣
lines: 第九章：解除婚约
只见白裙少女缓缓的站起身来，语气淡然的道：“此次，我并不是以药王谷大小姐的身份而来，而是以药神府青莲尊者嫡传弟子的身份，与天鹰堡叶重，解除十五年前的那一纸婚约。”。
眼神淡漠的扫了扫在场的众人，白裙女子接着沉声道：“何人是叶重，还请起来答话！”。
白裙少女的声音虽然很轻，但其话语却清晰的传达到了，在场每个人的耳中。
顿时，整个大厅为之一静。沈浩，沈泰等人，瞬时面露凝重之色；沈玥、沈彤二人，则是面容变得恼怒冰冷；一直面容古井不波的叶重，脸色也是变得难看了起来。当然，也有不少人，面露幸灾乐祸之色。
望着面色凝重难看，缓缓起身的叶重，周围的族中年轻人，都是忍不住的发出讥笑之声。
轻轻的吸了一口冰凉的空气，叶重那藏在袖间的手掌，却已是紧紧的握拢了起来。脸色微变，叶重压住心头猛的涌出的一阵怒气，沉声道：“在下就是天鹰堡叶重，不过在下对小姐所说，却知之不深，恕在下无法答应！”。
这怒气，并不是因为药曦对他的歧视。说实在的，对面的少女虽然足够吸引人，可他叶重也不是一个被下半身支配心智的色狼。就算与她结不成秦晋之好，那叶重也顶多只是有些遗憾而已，而且叶重对这种指腹为婚的封建婚约，也是略带反感。
可这药曦却在大庭广众下，对自己提出了解除婚约的请求。那么自己和天鹰堡的脸，可就算是丢尽了。日后不仅叶重，就算是他的母亲，也将会沦落为他人的笑柄，威严大失。
叶重很清楚，母亲孤身一人将自己拉扯大，遭受了多少白眼和议论。现在这药曦再来退婚这一出，只怕那些看不惯自己母子的人，再难听的话都是说的出来，再难看的事都是做的出来。
药曦退婚此举，对于叶重母子二人的状况来说，无异于雪上加霜。
有些事不一定要大张旗鼓的摆在台面上说，难道让自己的骄傲，建立在别人的痛苦之上，是一件很爽的事？
白裙少女皱了皱眉，眼神随即向叶重看来，心中也是暗叹一声：“倒是生了一副好皮囊！”。而其身旁的俏颜少女，却是一脸鄙视的对叶重讥讽道：“用这种蹩脚理由来推诿，真是白长了这副好皮囊！”。
看着与自己对视的叶重，蒙面少女却是冷声道：“嫣儿，不得胡说！”。
随即，柳腰微弯，诚恳的对叶重道：“叶重，我本无意如此做。只是家祖一直不同意，我与你解除婚约。所以此次才求得师尊的允许，以药王谷大小姐的身份，借师尊青莲尊者的名义，前来解除婚约，还望见谅！”。
当说完这句话的时候，只见那白纱少女的淡然眼眸之中，竟然闪过一丝疲惫，一丝解脱，和一丝愧意。
在五岁习武之后，药曦就表现出了绝佳的修炼天赋，让药王谷上下对其宠爱不已，更是被看做药王谷崛起的希望。
但当知道自己与一个素未谋面的男子有婚约时，药曦是吃惊和好奇；当知晓叶重是一个天赋低下的凡人时，药曦是失落和挣扎；当祖父不让解除婚约，药曦是不解和愤怒。
杵剑而立的站在，云雾弥漫，伫立于雄峰之上的宫殿楼宇的屋顶之上的药曦，看着有些朦胧大地，曾不止一次的对着药烈呐喊道：“爷爷，难道你不知道？将两个不同世界的人强行绑在一起，对谁而言都是不幸的；无论是将谁搪塞进另一个人的世界，都是不幸的吗？”。
但作为孙女的她，又岂会不懂药烈，往往很多时候，药烈决定的事情，谁也改变不了。他的霸道，药曦可是深有体会。否则又岂能被称为药火焚天，一剑烈日。
所以她拼了命去修炼，甚至在突破武师之后，不顾九死一生的危险，去降服那可以焚烧一切的灵火。但终于她成功了，被药神府的武尊强者，青莲尊者收为了嫡传弟子。
此时，她终于拥有了改变自己命运的力量。那么她会想尽办法，将自己不喜欢的事，解决掉。很不幸的，叶重与她的婚事，便是让她最不满意的地方。
现在无论药烈如何阻拦，有着药神府撑腰的药曦，终于可以做自己想做的事了。年仅十五岁的武师，在元武大陆这么多年的历史中，可唯有那寥寥数人而已。而且这几人，都早已经成为了元武修炼界中的泰山北斗。
更何况，她还是一位纳有灵火，灵魂天赋绝佳的炼丹天才。她的未来，将不可限量。那么她的人生道路，又岂是一纸婚约所能阻拦的。
看了眼渐露疲态之色的药曦，一直与众人谈笑风生的老者，却是站起身来，对着沈浩沉声道：“药曦少主征得青莲尊者的同意之后，以尊者的名义，希望沈堡主能够做主，解除了这婚约。而老夫就是为此事而来，希望双方在老夫的见证下，签下文书解除婚约！”。
在提到“尊者”二字时，宗云脸庞上的表情，也是变得略微郑重了起来。而在场的众人，在听到“尊者”二字时，其呼吸也是变得急促了起来。武尊，对他们来说，就像传说中的人物一般，可望而不可即。
虽然早有预料，但沈浩的嘴角，也忍不住的抽搐了几下，硕大的手掌微微颤抖，不过好在有着袖子的遮掩，所以也未曾被发现。强行压下心头的怒火，沈浩声音有些颤的凝声道：“宗云先生刚刚所说的请求，就是这个？而且你代表的并不是药王谷，而是那药神府？”。
content_en:
Chapter Nine: Dissolution of Engagement
The girl in the white dress slowly stood up and said in a calm tone: "This time, I am not here as the eldest lady of Yaowang Valley, but as the direct disciple of Lord Qinglian of Yaoshen Mansion, to terminate the engagement with Ye Zhong of Tianying Castle fifteen years ago."
Scanning the people present with indifferent eyes, the woman in the white dress then said in a deep voice: "Who is Ye Chong? Please get up and answer!".
Although the voice of the girl in the white dress was very soft, her words were clearly conveyed to the ears of everyone present.
Suddenly, the entire hall fell silent. Shen Hao, Shen Tai and others suddenly showed solemn expressions; Shen Yue and Shen Tong's expressions became angry and cold; Ye Zhong, who had always had a calm expression on his face, also became ugly. Of course, there are also many people who are gloating about the misfortune.
Looking at Ye Zhong, who stood up slowly with a solemn and ugly face, the young people in the clan around him couldn't help but laugh.
After taking a gentle breath of cold air, Ye Zhong's palms hidden in his sleeves were already tightly grasped. His face changed slightly, and Ye Zhong suppressed the anger that surged in his heart, and said in a deep voice: "I am Ye Zhong of Tianying Castle, but I don't know much about what I told the young lady. I'm sorry that I can't agree!"
This anger was not because of Yao Xi's discrimination against him. To be honest, although the girl opposite was attractive enough, Ye Chong was not a pervert whose mind was dominated by his lower body. Even if he couldn't get along with her as well as Qin and Jin, Ye Zhong would only have some regrets at most, and Ye Zhong was also slightly disgusted with this feudal marriage contract of fingertips.
But this Yao Xi made a request to herself to terminate the engagement in public. Then the face of himself and Tianying Castle would be completely lost. In the future, not only Ye Chong, but also his mother will become the laughing stock of others and lose her majesty.
Ye Chong knew very well how many looks and comments his mother had received while raising him up alone. Now that Yao Xi is back to break off the engagement, I'm afraid those who can't stand her mother and son will say the most ugly things and do the most ugly things.
Yao Xi's move to break off the engagement is nothing short of worsening the situation for Ye Zhong, mother and son.
Some things don’t have to be put on the table in a big way. Is it a good thing to let your pride be based on the pain of others?
The girl in the white dress frowned, then looked at Ye Zhong, and sighed secretly in her heart: "You have a good body!". But the pretty girl next to him sneered at Ye Chong with a look of contempt on his face: "Using such a lame excuse to shirk the blame is really a waste of time!"
Looking at Ye Zhong who was looking at her, the masked girl said coldly: "Yan'er, don't talk nonsense!".
Immediately, Liu Yao slightly bent and said sincerely to Ye Zhong: "Ye Chong, I had no intention of doing this. It's just that my ancestors have always disagreed, so I terminate the engagement with you. That's why I asked Master for permission this time. As the eldest lady of Yaowang Valley, I came to terminate the engagement in the name of Master Qinglian. I hope you will forgive me!"
When she finished saying this, a trace of exhaustion, a trace of relief, and a trace of guilt flashed through the indifferent eyes of the white-gauze girl.
After practicing martial arts at the age of five, Yao Xi showed excellent talent in training, and was loved by everyone in the Yaowang Valley. She was also seen as the hope for the rise of the Yaowang Valley.
But when she learned that she was engaged to a man she had never met, Yao Xi was surprised and curious; when she learned that Ye Zhong was a mortal with low talent, Yao Xi was disappointed and struggling; when her grandfather refused to terminate the engagement, Yao Xi was puzzled and angry.
Yao Xi stood with sword in hand, on the roof of the palace building filled with clouds and mist above the majestic peak. Looking at the hazy earth, she shouted to Yao Lie more than once: "Grandpa, don't you know? Forcibly tying people from two different worlds together is unfortunate for everyone; no matter who is thrust into another person's world, is it unfortunate?".
But as a granddaughter, how could she not understand Yao Lie? Often, no one can change the things Yao Lie decides. Yao Xi is well aware of his domineering attitude. Otherwise, how can it be called a fire that burns the sky or a sword that scorches the sun?
So she worked hard to practice, and even after breaking through as a martial artist, she ignored the danger of nine deaths to surrender the spiritual fire that could burn everything. But in the end she succeeded, and was accepted as a direct disciple by the powerful Martial Master of the Medicine God Mansion, the Master Qinglian.
At this time, she finally had the power to change her destiny. Then she will try her best to solve the things she doesn't like. Unfortunately, Ye Chong's marriage to her was what made her most dissatisfied.
Now, no matter how Yao Lie blocks it, Yao Xi, with the support of Yao Shen Mansion, can finally do what she wants to do. There are only a few martial arts masters who are only fifteen years old in the history of Yuanwu Continent for so many years. Moreover, these people have already become Taishan Beidou in the world of Yuanwu cultivation.
What's more, she is also an alchemy genius with spiritual fire and excellent soul talent. Her future will be limitless. Then her life path cannot be blocked by a marriage contract.
After looking at Yao Xi, who was gradually showing signs of fatigue, the old man who had been chatting and laughing with everyone stood up and said in a deep voice to Shen Hao: "After Young Master Yao Xi obtained the consent of Lord Qinglian, in the name of the Lord, she hopes that Lord Shen can make the decision and terminate the engagement. And I am here for this very reason. I hope that both parties will sign a document to terminate the engagement under my witness!"
When the word "venerable" was mentioned, the expression on Zong Yun's face became slightly solemn. When everyone present heard the word "Venerable", their breathing became rapid.
title_en: Chapter 9: Dissolution of Engagement Chapter 10: Mother and Son Prosperity Together
